name: input-kind
help: Explicit subject-wide feature table or feature-by-sample expression matrix; aggregate DE tables are not subject measurements

name: input
help: Direct independent measurements; exclusive with from-run

name: from-run
help: Upstream run with exact typed/hash/StudyContract validation before inference

name: object
help: Exact handoff object name, of the declared input-kind

name: sample-sheet
help: Independent-unit sheet containing ID, reference class and optional subgroup columns

name: id-col
help: Unique stable independent-unit ID; aligned by key, never row position

name: reference-col
help: Binary reference-standard column in sample sheet

name: markers
help: Distinct comma-separated marker IDs in deliberate order; first is primary, no data-driven feature selection

name: positive-class
help: Explicit positive reference class, never inferred

name: negative-class
help: Explicit negative reference class, distinct from positive

name: direction
help: One common declared marker direction; auto reversal is never reported

name: labels
help: Flat JSON map with distinct marker and class reader labels plus reference and population labels

name: cutpoint
help: none, finite prespecified value, youden, or closest.topleft; optimized values stay exploratory

name: cutpoint-source
help: Origin of a numeric primary threshold

name: cutpoint-rationale
help: Exact prior rationale/source for a numeric cutoff, not fitted from current data

name: cutpoints
help: Optional finite threshold grid; primary is retained and counts balance

name: internal-validation
help: Exploratory cutoff companion; original bootstrap attempts min(requested,200), explicitly counted

name: allow-optimistic-cutpoint
help: Original explicit missing-internal-validation override only; high QC remains, no acceptance implied

name: p-adjust
help: Explicit adjustment of all requested primary-versus-rest raw DeLong P values; pointwise difference CIs stay unadjusted

name: comparison-family
help: Original comparison family; no hidden all-pairs expansion

name: pauc
help: Two distinct probabilities in [0,1]; independently fitted uncorrected partial AUC with bootstrap CI

name: pauc-focus
help: Explicit axis defining the partial area

name: prevalence-grid
help: Explicit assumed prevalence probabilities in (0,1); projected PPV/NPV only, no Se/Sp transfer claim

name: subgroups
help: Explicit sheet columns; same primary threshold, sparse/single-class levels listed as skipped

name: confidence-level
help: Prespecified level strictly inside (0,1) for all stated confidence intervals

name: ci-method
help: Accuracy proportion CI only; full AUC remains native DeLong

name: bootstrap-reps
help: At least 100 requested draws for cutoff/pAUC/pointwise ROC band; internal validation retains original min(requested,200) cap

name: missing
help: Fail or explicitly declared complete-case analysis; paired marker sets must match exactly

name: indeterminate
help: Reference sentinel handling; all three fixed-cutoff sensitivity scenarios accompany observed indeterminacy

name: indeterminate-value
help: Explicit reference-side sentinel; must differ from both real classes

name: independent-unit
help: Actual independent unit; individual cells, lesions and technical repeats cannot stand for independent animals/donors

name: unit-description
help: Explain independence and any deliberate upstream aggregation

name: repeated-measures
help: This copied engine supports independent subjects only

name: dataset-name
help: Dataset label on each figure, not an attestation of real owner input

name: score-unit
help: Primary marker measurement scale/unit; comparator units belong in their labels

name: journal
help: OmicStat display preset only

name: study-contract
help: Exact independently declared StudyContract bytes, bound through handoff

name: development-mode
help: Explicit unsealed candidate execution only

name: seed
help: Recorded nonnegative native bootstrap seed

name: outdir
help: New or empty output directory

name: spec
help: Exact resolved-spec replay, explicit overrides retained
